Three levels of progress

1. Work completed

You corrected a listing, clarified a customer step, prepared useful content or finished another planned improvement.

2. Customer interest

People viewed your listing, followed a link, called, messaged or took another measurable action.

3. Business results

Only your own records can confirm customers, appointments, sales or revenue. Franklin Navigator should never treat activity as proof of those results.
